checkpoint.title: From Wild Zone 1's gate into the Research Lab

events.why: step 63: across the street into the Pokemon Research Lab's gate, into the rival's scene. Out of the zone's gate the player faces whichever way it faced before, so the walk first faces the street by the minimap arrow (257; the arrow shows the player's facing, not the camera's). Then straight down the street 6.5 s, left (the lab is on the street's left, the zone's fence on its right) into the gate, the only gap in the lab's wall and fence; walk_to_marker gets stuck on that fence. That leg is held until Ryon's dialog, which shows 9 to 11 s after the scene takes the marker away, hence 13 s. TO BE VERIFIED on console. not planned: Lumiose has no tile grid to plan a route target on.
step 63: Ryon at the lab gate; with five species registered he goes on, then the scene's black fade puts the player at the lab's steps (~20 s). The walk ends on his dialog, so the scene has started.
step 65: Ryon's scene at the lab gate after 5/5, until control; at once when research_lab_gate already played the whole scene. A bare scene: "a" would wait 45 s for a scene to start.

step 65: up the steps to the lab's "A Enter", by the objective marker. Its digits do not read on the steps, so the door's prompt counts with no read taken, but not after digits over 20 (from the street).

steps 65-66: A Enter, the receptionist: third floor; autosave (A first: the door's prompt shows with the party bar up). The door's black fade comes 0.5 s after A: control with no scene for 3 s is the player not at the door, not a pass.
the lobby's autosave was never seen in a run: X, Save, B here, so 03.10 starts from a save at this spot.

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game; split from 03.08 (user, 2026-11-14). Starts on the street just outside Wild Zone 1's far gate, where 03.08 ends; ends in the lab lobby with a menu save, 03.10's start: no run log shows the lobby's autosave (the 2026-11-14 21:02 run passed lab_lobby with no autosave badge logged). Start signature: party 5, out of the wild zone (no lead's panel). No A prompt in it: 03.08b's save stands where leave_zone_1 ends, which showed the party bar and no prompt once (console B, 2026-11-16 20:05:25), too few looks to rely on either way.
